tools.name: publish
tools.description:

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish · Private data: publish · Public sink: publish · Destructive: publish.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish · Private data: publish · Public sink: publish · Destructive: publish

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
